# jira-cloud-lite

> Minimal Jira Cloud REST v3 client in Go for enhanced JQL search, issue transitions and issue properties, with safe retries and no redirects. Go module `github.com/Trysac/u062-jira-cloud-lite`, package `jiracloudlite`, MIT licensed, Go >= 1.23, standard library only.

- [README](README.md): problem, install, usage example, API summary, limits

- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): shape of the package and its public API
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model
